entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A towering planeswalker huntsman and tracker who prefers a solitary life in the wilds and enlists beasts as allies.

events.summary: Garruk turned his back on civilization long ago, preferring a solitary life in the wilds.
events.quote: Garruk is a towering mountain of a man who turned his back on civilization long ago, preferring a solitary life in the wilds.
